k_heartbeat_ping.why: heartbeat detects dead connection and triggers reconnect

k_outbound_buffer.why: local buffer flushes queued sends after reconnect

k_push_fallback.why: push notification fallback, not socket recovery

k_reconnect_backoff.why: auto reconnect with exponential backoff and jitter

k_resume_cursor.why: replay after last-received id so nothing missed

k_ws_handshake.why: initial upgrade handshake, not reconnect recovery
